away.summary: The Flyers (0-5-3) are seeking their first win after a shootout loss to Seattle, showing improved play but continuing to struggle with early goals and special teams. They remain without injured defensemen Cam York and Rasmus Ristolainen, with young Oliver Bonk and David Jiricek stepping into the lineup. Travis Konecny leads in scoring despite missing games, while Matvei Michkov and Trevor Zegras are the only players with multiple goals.

returning: : J.T. Compher (undisclosed), who hasn’t played since Oct. 4, was back on the ice with his teammates — a group that didn’t include Justin Faulk and Lucas Raymond, as both took maintenance days and will suit up on Tuesday.
home.summary: The Red Wings (1-3-1) are looking to build momentum on a homestand, having recently practiced with leadership group discussions amid off-ice distractions. They continue to tinker with defensive pairs and line combinations due to injuries, missing Kasper and Appleton, while Compher is trending toward a return. The team remains relatively upbeat despite external noise, focusing on establishing a hard-to-play-against identity at home.
